comment: The campaign's level LIST (CampaignMapScreen, variant A picked by the user 2026-11-24): levels top to bottom. titleKey = the name; goalKey = the row's line under it; descKey = the picked card's short story; scene = the level's scene (empty: not built yet, «Скоро»); bestKey = its best time in PlayerPrefs; after = opens once that level is done (empty: the one before it); label = the medal's number (empty: its place); film = a story scene; side = a SIDE story (not the main line), listed under «Побочные истории», opened for crystals later (the user picked list marking C, 2026-11-24); closed = shut until release whatever the progress (the user, 2026-11-24: the player plays up to the prologue; a lock in place of «Играть»). The preview is UI/Campaign/Preview_<id>.png (Tools/campaign/campaign_list_art.py).
